checks.detail: Condition-stratified and aggregate directions were checked; no complete all-condition reversal was detected.
Inference is explicitly restricted to repeated complete blocks in the eight fixed conditions; agent- or frame-level records are not treated as independent n.
All 1,536 preregistered valid blocks were committed; there was no outcome-based block selection and no whole-block replacement.
The primary paired analysis does not condition on post-treatment performance variables; M2 missingness uses one shared four-algorithm mask rule.
The study is not a diagnostic-classification analysis. Reliability counts and denominators are reported directly.
Conditions and blocks were not selected from extreme observed Gate 14Re outcomes, and prior-study effects were inadmissible.
Algorithm noncompletion remains an outcome through the M1 cap and M3 terminal states; all complete formal blocks are retained.
The primary M1 family contains the six preregistered unordered algorithm pairs and uses Holm-adjusted p-values; no result-driven endpoint search was performed.
The Phase B contract, estimands, exclusions, multiplicity family, decision margins, and conservative simultaneous intervals were frozen before formal block outcomes were opened.
Algorithm comparisons are controlled within-block interventions in fixed scenarios, but conclusions are not generalized to untested scenarios, hardware, or workloads.
Algorithm identity is assigned by the frozen Williams order and precedes the measured run; outcomes cannot determine algorithm identity.

reproducibility.method: deterministic synthetic known-answer tests plus post-commit in-memory recomputation available
